legal.softwareNature: B4S is independent, non-commercial, open-source software for research, technical compatibility and personal use. It is not sponsored, certified, warranted or officially affiliated with Baseus or any earbud manufacturer.
legal.dataConnection: Device controls run locally over Bluetooth. No account is required, and usage, device or personal data is not sent to a server. The app works offline; internet is only needed when you choose to check for updates or open an external link.
legal.modelSupport: Baseus Bass BP1 Ultra, part of the BP1 protocol family, is the primary test device. Recognizing BP1 Pro or another model does not mean it has been verified, is fully compatible or is supported by its manufacturer.
legal.userResponsibility: You are responsible for connecting, updating firmware and changing volume, EQ, ANC or spatial audio settings. B4S does not guarantee compatibility, uninterrupted operation or firmware recovery.
legal.hearingSafety: Find earbuds may play a loud sound. Remove them before confirming, keep the volume at a safe level and stop if you feel pain, ringing or discomfort.
more.title: More audio settings
more.osCodecNote: LDAC and hearing protection are often managed by the Bluetooth system. This toggle is saved in B4S; a PC may not change codecs like a phone app.
